text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, when Yamanin Zephyr and I
are getting
ready to head back after
training...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I've still got way more running in me
today! I'm
going around again!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I can still run for a while longer too.
I'll
join you
until my energy is entirely
spent.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr watches intently as
other
students throw themselves into
some rigorous
independent training.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Would it be all right if we trained for
just a little
longer?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I've been hit by a scorching hot gale.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It would be a waste to simply embrace
this wind in
silence...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
If I utilize it as a tailwind, I can blow
ahead with
increased fervor.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Yes,
that is an option. Strong winds are the
result of gradually generated
atmospheric
pressure, after all.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Very good. In our next training session,
I'll blow
ahead with all the might I can
manage.
